name: Perforce
description: Inspect Perforce depots, changelists, shelves, workspaces, jobs, reviews, and streams.
installHint: Runs the official Perforce P4 MCP Server bundled in the Sandbox Server image in read-only mode. Add a separate named connection for each Perforce server. P4PASSWD accepts a password or login ticket and remains encrypted in this connection's MCP environment. P4CLIENT is intentionally omitted; set a workspace later only when client-specific operations are needed.

envFields.label: Perforce server
envFields.helperText: P4PORT for this connection, including ssl: when the server requires TLS.

envFields.label: Perforce username
envFields.helperText: P4USER used to connect to this Perforce server.

envFields.label: Perforce password or ticket
envFields.placeholder: Password or ticket from p4 login -p
envFields.helperText: Use a password or, preferably, a ticket from `p4 login -p`. The value remains encrypted in this connection's MCP environment.
